params.body:
Elixir signs a narrowing in the digest form once the gateway reads it, and reports the forms the gateway reads to Portal.

The gateway (control, policy-digest) accepts a version signed on a short head that names its body by hash. `Client::policy` now returns the `formats` from `GET /v1/policy`; `PolicyLog::sign` makes the three-part token when the gateway lists `digest`, and the whole-payload form otherwise, since a version in a form the gateway does not read blocks the chain. `controlGrants` carries the formats from `/v1/agents`, so Portal signs a passkey repair in a form the gateway takes.

Tests: the existing narrowing test pins the old form for a gateway that lists no forms; a new one checks the head, the body, the hash between them and that the signature covers the head only. Full suite 736 of 736, PHPStan and Pint clean.
